display_long_description:
Your city. Your choices. Your story.

Trap Life 2: RICO is a multiplayer VR open-world roleplaying experience where you decide how to build your reputation.

Explore Ocean City, drive through the streets, buy and customize cars, earn cash, complete missions, purchase weapons, build your character, hang out with other players, and create your own story.

Choose your path. Build a crew and rise through the streets, become a police officer and enforce the law, chase money through jobs and businesses, or simply explore the city with friends.

Features include:
• Multiplayer VR roleplay
• Large open-world city
• Cars and vehicle customization
• Police and criminal roleplay
• Jobs, missions and activities
• Player progression and levels
• Weapons and combat
• Properties and stash houses
• Social locations and nightlife
• Character customization

Every session can play differently depending on the people you meet and the choices you make.

Control Your Destiny.

👉 Join the city: discord.gg/TrapLifeVR

Welcome to Trap Life 2: RICO.
